tools.description: Run a bash command in the agent's persistent shell session (cwd /workspace). Returns merged stdout/stderr and the exit status. Output over ~30 KB keeps only its head and tail.

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds, default 120, max 600. A timeout resets the session.

tools.name: shell

tools.description: Read a text file with line numbers. Relative paths resolve under /workspace.
tools.name: read_file

tools.description: Create or replace a file with the given content; parent directories are created.
tools.name: write_file

tools.description: Replace an exact string in a file. old_string must match exactly once unless replace_all is true.
tools.name: edit_file

tools.description: Open a URL in the box's Chrome and return the page snapshot: headings, text and interactive elements tagged [ref=eN].
tools.name: browser_navigate

tools.description: Return the current page as a ref-tagged element list. Refs from older snapshots become invalid.
tools.name: browser_snapshot

tools.description: Click the element with the given ref from the latest snapshot.
tools.name: browser_click

tools.description: Focus the element with the given ref and type text into it.
tools.name: browser_type

tools.description: Return the visible text of the page, or of one element by ref.
tools.name: browser_read

tools.description: Look at the desktop: a read-only screenshot of the whole 1280x800 screen.

max_edge.description: Scale the screenshot so its long edge is at most this many pixels; x,y then refer to the scaled image

tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Screenshot of the whole 1280x800 screen, the visible windows (pid, window_id), and the accessibility elements [index] of the frontmost window or of the given pid.

max_edge.description: Scale the screenshot so its long edge is at most this many pixels; x,y then refer to the scaled image

query.description: Only elements whose text contains this

tools.name: computer_state

tools.description: Perform one input action, then return a fresh screenshot. Target an element by index from the latest computer_state, or screen coordinates x,y.

element.description: Element index from the latest computer_state

foreground.description: Raise the target window and inject there; use when a background action had no visible effect

key.description: key: e.g. return, tab, escape, a

max_edge.description: Scale the screenshot so its long edge is at most this many pixels; x,y then refer to the scaled image

tools.name: computer_act
